<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  /* =========================
     FAQ ACCORDION
  ========================== */
  const plusIcon = 'https://res.cloudinary.com/cgibjxmm/image/upload/v1785922086/custom-cms/faq-plus-icon.png';
  const minusIcon = 'https://res.cloudinary.com/cgibjxmm/image/upload/v1785922085/custom-cms/faq-minus-icon.png';

  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
      const currentItem = button.closest('.faq-item');

      if (!currentItem) {
        return;
      }

      const isOpen = currentItem.classList.contains('active');

      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function (faqItem) {
        const control = faqItem.querySelector('.faq-question');
        const icon = control ? control.querySelector('img') : null;

        faqItem.classList.remove('active');

        if (control) {
          control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }

        if (icon) {
          icon.src = plusIcon;
        }
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        const currentIcon = button.querySelector('img');

        currentItem.classList.add('active');
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

        if (currentIcon) {
          currentIcon.src = minusIcon;
        }
      }
    });
  });

  /* =========================
     MEET THE TEAM PAGINATION
  ========================== */
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-team-pagination]').forEach(function (component) {
    const cards = Array.from(component.querySelectorAll('.team-card'));
    const pageList = component.querySelector('[data-team-pages]');
    const previousButton = component.querySelector('[data-team-prev]');
    const nextButton = component.querySelector('[data-team-next]');

    if (!cards.length || !pageList || !previousButton || !nextButton) {
      return;
    }

    let currentPage = 1;
    let itemsPerPage = getItemsPerPage();

    function getItemsPerPage() {
      if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches) {
        return 1;
      }

      if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)').matches) {
        return 2;
      }

      return 3;
    }

    function renderPagination() {
      const totalPages = Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(cards.length / itemsPerPage)
      );

      currentPage = Math.min(currentPage, totalPages);

      const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
      const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;

      cards.forEach(function (card, index) {
        card.hidden = index < startIndex || index >= endIndex;
      });

      pageList.innerHTML = '';

      for (let page = 1; page <= totalPages; page += 1) {
        const pageButton = document.createElement('button');

        pageButton.type = 'button';
        pageButton.textContent = page;
        pageButton.setAttribute(
          'aria-label',
          'Show team page ' + page
        );

        if (page === currentPage) {
          pageButton.classList.add('is-active');
          pageButton.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
        }

        pageButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
          currentPage = page;
          renderPagination();
        });

        pageList.appendChild(pageButton);
      }

      previousButton.disabled = currentPage === 1;
      nextButton.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
    }

    previousButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (currentPage > 1) {
        currentPage -= 1;
        renderPagination();
      }
    });

    nextButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      const totalPages = Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(cards.length / itemsPerPage)
      );

      if (currentPage < totalPages) {
        currentPage += 1;
        renderPagination();
      }
    });

    let resizeTimer;

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

      resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
        const newItemsPerPage = getItemsPerPage();

        if (newItemsPerPage !== itemsPerPage) {
          itemsPerPage = newItemsPerPage;
          currentPage = 1;
          renderPagination();
        }
      }, 150);
    });

    renderPagination();
  });
});
</script>
